items.name: couple-editorial
items.text: posed as a fashion-editorial couple, her back settled against his chest, both squared to the lens

items.name: cinematic-embrace
items.text: the man standing behind the woman with arms gently wrapped around her waist as she leans back

items.name: bedside-recline-pair
items.text: the woman reclining on the bed while the man sits on the edge, a hand resting on her knee

items.name: loft-sofa-couple
items.text: the man seated on the sofa with the woman leaning back comfortably between his knees

items.name: sidelight-window-couple
items.text: both standing near the window, the man in side profile while the woman turns toward the camera

items.name: lounge-booth-couple
items.text: the man resting an elbow on the leather booth backrest while the woman sits close beside him

items.name: slow-dance-dip
items.text: a slow-dance dip, her hand curled at the back of his neck

items.name: forehead-touch
items.text: standing forehead to forehead, eyes closed, hands joined

items.name: mirror-couple
items.text: he stands behind her at the vanity mirror, hands resting on her waist, both regarding her reflection

items.name: hand-kiss
items.text: he bows his head to press a kiss to her extended knuckles, her fingers curved over his
